_doc: Medium batch m10 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

stink-badger/f:u3.note: boot stink is a reek cloud: puff, keeps Musk Spray as the only drip

stink-badger/f:u2.note: hiding in undergrowth; avoids a second puff next to Boot Stink; best guess

tunnel-mole/f:u2.note: flung clods hit hard: bash (trip tag, no keyword); best guess

tunnel-mole/f:b3.note: soil eruption = dust burst: puff; Dirt Toss keeps bash weight

tunnel-mole/f:u3.note: ground tremor rings as it vanishes, avoids a second puff; best guess

star-nosed-mole/f:u3.note: wetland probe in wet silt: ripple, not a second shock

star-nosed-mole/f:b0.note: a prod is a lance poke: thrust

mole-rat-gang/f:u1.note: buck-tooth jab rush: thrust, shock needs a Critter swarm; best guess

mole-rat-gang/f:u2.note: burrow call kicks up dust: puff, art beats bash tag; best guess

mole-rat-gang/f:b1.note: pile-on of many bodies: bash, separates it from Colony Swarm Rake

golden-mole/f:u0.note: sand swimming = sand waves: ripple, art beats pierce tag; best guess

golden-mole/f:u3.note: blind lunge head-first: thrust, not shock

barn-rat/f:b2.note: hay stack: leaf (plant wall), distinct from other shields

barn-rat/f:u3.note: quick nip at grain: slash, avoids a second bite with Grudge Gnaw

marsh-rat/f:u0.note: reed gnaw is a chew: bite, art beats bash tag; best guess

marsh-rat/f:u1.note: bank burrow digging dust: puff; best guess

marsh-rat/f:u2.note: reed shove: leaf, reed is a plant

pack-rat/f:u2.note: tossed shiny trinkets: sparkle, art beats bash tag; best guess

bramble-pup-pack/f:u3.note: burr tumble raises dust: puff; best guess, avoids second thorn

thorn-jackal/f:b2.note: thorn tangle in the coat: thorn beats web keyword
